options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), append JOBLOG to stderr/stderr_lines.

options.name: message_lib
options.description: The library name which contains message queue.

options.name: message_text
options.description: The message text of the message.

options.name: message_type
options.description: The type of the message. INFORMATIONAL, A message that conveys information about the condition of a function. COMPLETION, A message that conveys completion status of work. DIAGNOSTIC, A message about errors in the processing of a system function, in an application program, or in input data. ESCAPE, A message that describes a condition for which a procedure or program must end abnormally. A procedure or program can monitor for the arrival of escape messages from the program or procedure it calls
